performance.verdict: All paid channels are dark; only GBP is active and fading.

findings.text: Zero spend, zero leads, zero clicks across Meta and Google Ads for the full 28-day window — paid engine is completely off.
GA4 sessions down 43.75% week-over-week; last 3 days (Sep 7–9) averaged 5 sessions vs. prior 3 days (Sep 4–6) averaging 6.3 — organic softening is confirmed trend, not a spike.
GBP actions flat at 0% week-over-week delta but spiked to 11 on Aug 25 then dropped to 0 for the last 4 days — engagement is erratic and declining.
GHL pipeline shows null — no pipeline data available. With 0 paid leads in 28 days, no intake leak diagnosis is possible; CRM health is unknown.

suggestions.text: Confirm campaign pause status in Meta and Google Ads accounts; if paused intentionally, document the resume date.
suggestions.monday_update: Both Meta and Google Ads show $0 spend across the full 28-day window — no leads, no clicks, no impressions. Sohib to check platform dashboards and confirm whether campaigns are intentionally paused or have a billing/account issue. Success check: confirmation of campaign status (paused vs. active) by 2026-09-12. If unintentionally dark, reactivation plan needed immediately.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 sessions over next 3 days; if daily average stays below 5, organic floor may require GBP or content action.
